notes.title: v1.2.9 Update
notes.content:
- Fixed black dot that overlap red dot on spawn, now it find a new position when the black dot is overlapped, we have not removed the button to respawn black dot in case random bug happen.

- Fixed exploit for the first jump where player dont move, now player automatically move on the first jump to prevent idle jump bot. 

- Added Pause & Unpause with ESC & P.

- Added Restart with R on dead screen.

- The player is now less heavy.
